bow_shoot: A standing archer reaches over the right shoulder with the right hand, draws a bow from the back into the left hand, takes an arrow, nocks it, raises the bow with the left arm straight forward, pulls the string back to the right cheek with the right hand, aims, releases the shot, then lowers the bow to the side.
pick_hare: A person kneels down on one knee, picks up a small animal from the ground with the right hand, stands up and puts it into a sack hanging at the right hip.
scan_bow: A person stands still holding a bow down in the left hand, listening carefully and slowly turning the head to scan left and right, with small weight shifts.
